neighbours.label: the marker that introduces an alternative spelling or form of a name (the comma between spelling variants, 'or chi', 'originally spelled', 'in Yiddish'); the same sentence without a variant stays low
fire: The Meyer family (Mayer, Maier) came from a village near Stuttgart.
In yoga, the cakra or chakra is a centre of energy in the body.
A storey (or story in American usage) is one level of a building.
The hero Siegfried (originally spelled Sigurd) slays the dragon Fafnir.
Parish records list the name as Thompson, Tomson, Thomsen, etc.
Peking (now usually spelled Beijing) is the capital of China.
The city of Vilnius (Wilno in Polish) changed hands several times.
Recorded forms of the name include Catherine, Katharine, Kathryn and Katrin.
quiet: The Meyer family came from a village near Stuttgart and grew grapes.
In yoga, the breath is a centre of energy in the body.
A storey is one level of a building, usually about three metres high.
The hero Siegfried slays the dragon Fafnir and bathes in its blood.
Parish records list the name next to that of his wife and children.

The city of Vilnius changed hands several times during the war.
Recorded uses of the name are common in old church registers.
